column1: # Watson-Crick nearest-neighbour thermodynamic parameters for DNA in 1 M NaCl.
# Parameter set: SantaLucia & Hicks (2004), Annu. Rev. Biophys. Biomol. Struct.
# 33:415-440, Table 1. See README.md for how each value was verified and why
# this set was chosen over the 1997/1998 one.
# dH: kcal/mol. dS: cal/(K mol) ("e.u." in the source).
# Sign convention is the source's: duplex formation is exothermic, so dH < 0.
# Non-motif terms. "initiation" is applied once per duplex. "terminal_AT" is
# applied once for each duplex end closed by an A-T pair. "symmetry" is applied
